name: Konshuu mo Otsukare-san!
source:
I'm a new worker on a construction project at a park.
Doing manual labor under the hot sun and the gaze
of the strict foremen, it's pretty hard work.

But soon it'll be the weekend!
That's when all the fun begins...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE277087.html]DLsite English[/url]]
